defect_summary: After ship GO, the producer session printed a human checklist instead of invoking ./release.
unsuitable_process: The release skill's Step 6 is prose that says run ./release and do not dump steps, but nothing refuses a chat checklist. A missing origin release/v* was treated as a reason to skip the orchestrator.
climb_steps: Chat listed human steps instead of Planner stdout.
Skill Step 6 is a command fence with no machine refuse when chat substitutes a list.
CREATE_RELEASE_LINE does not require origin/release/v* to exist first.
ADR 0038 forbids memory rituals; ADR 0049 requires planner-owned stops.

repo_touch.belief: ADR 0025 — defects name unsuitable process, not agents
